entries.speaker: The Final Heist
entries.en: In Mementos, the team finally finds its Treasure, the[n][clr 2]Holy Grail[clr 27]. However, by the will of the masses,[n]it has transformed into a malevolent god.

entries.speaker: The Final Heist
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are defeated, and the Grail[n]begins to merge Mementos with reality. The team[n]awakens to see Shibuya distorted, as they helplessly[n]begin to fade.

entries.speaker: The Final Heist
entries.en: It is revealed that the malevolent god has been[n]masquerading as Igor and stringing [fName][n]along in its game—one he never stood a chance[n]at winning.

entries.speaker: The Final Heist
entries.en: The Meta-Nav and Metaverse were both tools[n]used by the malevolent god to prove the[n]foolishness of humanity to [fName].

entries.speaker: The Final Heist
entries.en: [fName] is saved from death when the Velvet[n]Room twins merge into Lavenza. The god, believing it[n]has already won, returns the real Igor and leaves.

entries.speaker: The Final Heist
entries.en: [fName] restores the Phantom Thieves'[n]willpower and the team gathers in the Velvet[n]Room for Igor's explanation.

entries.speaker: The Final Heist
entries.en: Before being imprisoned, Igor gave his remaining[n]power to a messenger tasked with finding a human[n]that could become the Trickster.

entries.speaker: The Final Heist
entries.en: Morgana, no longer uncertain about himself,[n]leads the Phantom Thieves to face their[n]final opponent.

entries.speaker: The Final Heist
entries.en: So begins the final battle against the malevolent god,[n]with the fate of the world hanging in the balance...
